item.text:
**4B.4 Research Note**

Overall read: **mixed, leaning positive**. Lula’s 2024 record includes several concrete moves that strengthened oversight and accountability institutions, especially police oversight, civilian participation, indigenous councils, and anti-corruption/technical review bodies. The main caveat is that some media/information-policy moves pushed toward tighter control, and HRW shows police-oversight systems were still incomplete in practice.

- [Discurso do presidente Lula no evento à margem da Assembleia Geral das Nações Unidas em defesa da democracia, lutando contra o extremismo](https://www.gov.br/g20/pt-br/documentos/discursos/discurso-do-presidente-lula-no-evento-a-margem-da-assembleia-geral-das-nacoes-unidas-em-defesa-da-democracia-lutando-contra-o-extremismo) — Governo do Brasil / G20 — 2024-09-24 — Lula described democracy as requiring free and fair elections, transparent political processes, separation of powers, organizing rights, and protection of human rights. That is a broad pro-oversight statement, including the idea that power must remain constrained by institutions. Question IDs: `4B.4` `4B.1` `4B.3`

- [Lula reafirma que não aceita vitória de Maduro sem provas](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/08/30/lula-reafirma-que-nao-aceita-vitoria-de-maduro-sem-provas.htm) — Reuters via UOL — 2024-08-30 — Lula said he would not accept declared victory without proof, urged publication of vote records, and proposed a suprapartisan electoral committee with international observers. This is direct support for electoral oversight institutions and evidence-based verification. Question IDs: `4B.4` `4B.1` `4B.3`

- [Decreto cria o Sistema Nacional de Acompanhamento e Combate à Violência nas Escolas](https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12006.htm) — Presidência da República / Planalto — 2024-04-24 — Lula created SNAVE, a national system to monitor and combat school violence, linking reporting channels to federal coordination. This is a targeted oversight-and-response institution, not just a one-off order, and it strengthens preventive state capacity. Question IDs: `4B.4` `3B.9` `3B.7`

- [Presidente Lula assina decreto que atualiza regras para a implementação de políticas públicas em parcerias com as organizações da sociedade civil](https://www.gov.br/secretariageral/pt-br/noticias/2024/marco/presidente-lula-assina-decreto-que-atualiza-regras-para-a-implementacao-de-politicas-publicas-em-parcerias-com-as-organizacoes-da-sociedade-civil) — Secretaria-Geral da Presidência — 2024-03-13 — Lula updated federal rules for civil-society partnerships with the stated goal of democratizing access to public-policy partnerships. That strengthens non-state oversight and organized civic participation. Question IDs: `4B.4` `4B.3` `3B.8`

- [Conselho Nacional de Política Indigenista é reaberto com cerimônia de posse no Palácio da Justiça](https://www.gov.br/povosindigenas/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/04/conselho-nacional-de-politica-indigenista-e-reaberto-com-cerimonia-de-posse-no-palacio-da-justica) — Ministério dos Povos Indígenas — 2024-04-16 — The government reopened the National Council of Indigenous Policy and restored a formal venue for Indigenous participation that had been eliminated under Bolsonaro. This is strong evidence of strengthening a constraining oversight/consultation institution. Question IDs: `4B.4` `3B.7` `3B.8`

- [Presidente Lula reafirma compromisso com homologações de terras indígenas e convoca força-tarefa](https://www.gov.br/povosindigenas/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/04/presidente-lula-reafirma-compromisso-com-homologacoes-de-terras-indigenas-e-convoca-forca-tarefa) — Ministério dos Povos Indígenas — 2024-04-26 — Lula met with Indigenous leaders and ordered a multi-ministry task force to advance long-delayed land homologations. This supports institutional channels that can constrain executive discretion by forcing inter-ministry review and Indigenous participation. Question IDs: `4B.4` `3B.7` `3B.8`

- [Lula delivers more than 120,000 hectares to 4,500 quilombolas](https://www.gov.br/igualdaderacial/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/governo-federal-destina-mais-de-120-mil-hectares-a-4-5-mil-quilombolas) — Ministério da Igualdade Racial — 2024-09-19 — Lula delivered land titles to quilombola communities, responding to a decades-long territorial claim. This is consistent with reinforcing institutions that protect vulnerable groups and remedy neglect. Question IDs: `4B.4` `3B.7` `3B.8`

- [Casa Civil apresenta medidas implementadas na Terra Yanomami à Corte Interamericana de Direitos Humanos](https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/maio/casa-civil-apresenta-medidas-implementadas-na-terra-yanomami-a-corte-interamericana-de-direitos-humanos/) — Casa Civil — 2024-05-23 — The government presented Yanomami remediation measures to the Inter-American Court, indicating it was willing to subject its response to external human-rights scrutiny. This is one of the clearest examples of accepting a constraining oversight body. Question IDs: `4B.4` `3B.7` `3B.9`

- [Relatório do MJSP apresenta diagnóstico sobre o uso de câmeras corporais policiais](https://www.gov.br/mj/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/relatorio-do-mjsp-apresenta-diagnostico-sobre-o-uso-de-cameras-corporais-policiais) — Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública — 2024-07-31 — The ministry published a review linking body cameras to lower police lethality and more reporting. That is direct evidence of strengthening civilian oversight over security forces. Question IDs: `4B.4` `3B.1` `3B.2` `3B.6` `3B.7` `3B.9`

- [Decreto que atualiza regras sobre o uso diferenciado da força pelas polícias é publicado](https://www.gov.br/mj/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/decreto-que-atualiza-regras-sobre-o-uso-diferenciado-da-forca-pelas-policias-e-publicado) — Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública — 2024-12-24 — Lula signed a decree updating police use-of-force rules and less-lethal instruments, framed around legality, precaution, necessity, due process, and non-discrimination. This is the strongest 2024 institutional reform aimed at constraining state violence through rules. Question IDs: `4B.4` `3B.1` `3B.2` `3B.6` `3B.9`

- [Brazil | World Report 2025](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2025/country-chapters/brazil) — Human Rights Watch — 2025-01-01, covering 2024 events — HRW reported continued police killings, very limited charging in major cases, and prison conditions marked by overcrowding and ill-treatment/torture. This is strong counterevidence that oversight institutions still had not fully constrained abusive state practice by the end of 2024. Question IDs: `4B.4` `3B.1` `3B.2` `3B.6` `3B.7` `3B.9`

- [Brazil | 2024 country chapter](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/brazil) — Human Rights Watch — 2024 — HRW said Brazil still had not fully implemented independent-investigation requirements for police killings and that lethal raids, unlawful force, intimidation, and evidence tampering continued. This is the best counterpoint to the positive reform evidence: Lula strengthened some oversight tools, but they were not yet fully effective in practice. Question IDs: `4B.4` `3B.1` `3B.2` `3B.6` `3B.7` `3B.9`

Search gap: I did **not** find strong 2024 evidence that Lula materially strengthened the legislature itself or independent courts in a way that was clearly tested by a direct conflict with his own power. The strongest evidence is instead around executive-backed oversight reforms, civil-society access, Indigenous consultation, and external human-rights review, offset by incomplete enforcement on police abuse.
